name: talents-registry
description: Talents (talents.sh) skills meta-registry — P0 core engine + CLI. Catalog, not CDN: indexes skills in place from their original sources.

scripts.ingest: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js ingest
scripts.ingest-repo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js ingest-repo
scripts.show: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js show
scripts.index: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js index
scripts.search: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js search
scripts.serve: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js serve
scripts.aggregate: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js aggregate
scripts.discover: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js discover
scripts.gate:creator: node scripts/gate-creator.mjs
scripts.gate: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js ingest anthropics/skills --out data/registry.json --summary data/gate-skills.json && node dist/src/cli.js ingest anthropics/claude-plugins-official --limit 25 --out data/registry.json --summary data/gate-official.json && npm test 2>&1 | tail -30 | tee data/test-output.txt
